requirements.requirement: The system must map raw phase value 'I' to a predefined consumer-friendly explanation string.
The system must map raw phase value 'II' to a predefined consumer-friendly explanation string.
The system must map raw phase value 'III' to a predefined consumer-friendly explanation string.
The system must map raw phase value 'IV' to a predefined consumer-friendly explanation string.
The system must normalize raw phase values into a standardized label format (e.g., 'Phase I', 'Phase II', 'Phase III', 'Phase IV').
The system must compute a normalized score contribution value based on the phase according to a deterministic mapping.
The system must ensure that higher phases (III/IV) produce greater or equal score contributions than lower phases (I/II).
The system must output interpretation results in the data contract defined by EVAL-CT-PHASE-UX-S1.
The system must include both explanation text and score contribution fields in the interpretation output.
The system must produce consistent interpretation outputs for identical input phase values across multiple executions.
The system must handle lowercase or variant inputs (e.g., 'i', 'ii', 'phase iii') by normalizing them to valid phase values before interpretation.
The system must return a fallback explanation indicating 'phase information unavailable or unknown' when the input phase value is missing.
The system must return a fallback explanation indicating 'unrecognized phase value' when the input phase value is not one of the supported phases (I, II, III, IV).
The system must assign a neutral or zero score contribution when the phase value is missing or unrecognized.
The system must ensure that all explanation strings are plain-language and do not contain clinical jargon beyond basic terms like 'safety' or 'effectiveness'.
